To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e. 2021-2022 to 2025-26 mandating satisfactory completion as a prime contractor for at least Any Truss And Steel Work to an extent of Rs. 2.75 Lakhs

Liquid assets and or availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs 1.65 Lakhs in the form of Credit lines or Letters of Credit or Certificates from Banks for meeting the fund requirement Conditional bankers certificate not acceptable
